name: Magnesium
active_ingredient: Magnesium (from magnesium oxide, magnesium citrate, magnesium bisglycinate, or magnesium malate)
allowed_claims: Helps in the development and maintenance of bones.
A factor in the maintenance of good health.
Helps to maintain healthy muscle function.
Aids in supporting a restful sleep.
duration_of_use: Long-term use. Consult a health care practitioner if symptoms persist.

cautions: Consult a health care practitioner if symptoms persist beyond 4 weeks.
May cause diarrhea or laxative effect, especially at higher doses.
Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you have kidney disease.
contraindications: Do not use if you are hypersensitive to any of the ingredients.
